text.p: Immunex Corp said its interleukin-4R compound was shown to be safe and well tolerated in tests on sixteen mild asthmatic patients.

"We are pleased that IL-4 receptor was found in this study to be very safe at the doses tested in these mild asthma patients," said Leslie Garrison, medical director of Immunex. "We are encouraged that there are hints of biologic response as well, which we will further test."
The company said additional Phase I/II studies are now underway to further explore the safety, efficacy and optimal method of administration of IL-4R for treating allergic asthma.
Interleukin-4R is an immune system protein, manufactured by Immunex that binds to a neutralizes the activity of another immune system protein, IL-4.
